PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday OCTOBER 8, 2020
7:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.
1. CALL TO ORDER
2. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE TO THE FLAG
3. ROLL CALL:
Chair Nemeth, Vice Chair Avery, Commissioner Fraga-Saenz, Henderson, and Smith
4. REVIEW OF AGENDA
5. MOTION TO WAIVE FULL READING OF ALL RESOLUTIONS ON THE AGENDA FOR THIS MEETING
6. PUBLIC COMMENTS ON CONSENT CALENDAR ITEMS AND ANY ITEMS NOT ON THE AGENDA
7. CONSENT CALENDAR
Approval of Minutes from the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of September 10, 2020
Minutes
8. NEW BUSINESS
Presentation - Measure AV
Marie Ricci, Assistant City Manager
9. PUBLIC HEARINGS
9A. Tentative Tract Map 73158 Time Extension No. 1
Challman Engineering, Inc., Applicant
A request for a first three-year discretionary time extension for Tentative Tract Map 73158 for the subdivision of 39.31 acres into 104 lots for the construction of 102
single-family residences and one detention basin on two lots. The site is located east of 42nd Street East between Avenue Q and Palmdale Boulevard.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt RESOLUTION NO. PC-2020-042 approving Tentative Tract Map 73158 Time Extension No. 1 and find that the project is consistent with the previously approved Mitigated Negative Declaration.
Staff Reference: Jasmine Alvarado, Assistant Planner
TTM 73158 TE No. 1
9B. Zoning Ordinance Amendment 20-004
City of Palmdale, Applicant
The proposed Zoning Ordinance Amendment would amend various sections of Title 17 (Zoning Code) of the Palmdale Municipal Code to streamline how the code is
used, clarify, and eliminate ambiguity and ensure consistency throughout the document.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt RESOLUTION NO. PC-2020-037 recommending approval of Zoning Ordinance Amendment 20-004 and find that the project is not subject to the California Environmental Quality Act.
Staff Reference: Benjamin Fiss, Senior Planner
ZOA 20-004
9C. North County ITS Palmdale Extension Project (PAL-008)
City of Palmdale, Applicant
The North County ITS Palmdale Extension project will upgrade the existing transportation and traffic signal control system at various locations throughout the City.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt RESOLUTION NO. PC-2020-041, based on the authority provided under Section 65402 of the California Government Code, setting forth a finding that the acquisition of land associated with the North County Intelligent Transportation System Palmdale Extension project (PAL-008) is consistent with the goals, policies, and objectives of the General Plan and adopt the Mitigated Negative Declaration and Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program prepared for the project.
Staff Reference: Benjamin Fiss, Senior Planner
PAL-008
9D. General Plan Amendment 20-002, Zone Change 20-002, Specific Plan Amendment 20-001, and Specific Plan 20-001
City of Palmdale, Applicant
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt RESOLUTION NO. PC-2020-038 recommending that the City Council approve General Plan Amendment
20-002, Zone Change 20-002, Specific Plan Amendment 20-001, and Specific Plan 20-001 and adopt the Negative Declaration prepared for the project.
Staff Reference: Megan Taggart, Acting Planning Manager
(1) General Plan Amendment 20-002 to repeal the Palmdale Transit Village Specific Plan in accordance with California Government Code Section 65453 and amend the land use designations within the SPL 20-001 area from various designations to SP – Palmdale Transit Area;
(2) Zone Change 20-002 to amend the zoning designation within the SPL 20-001 area from various designations to SP – Palmdale Transit Area;
(3) Specific Plan Amendment 20-001 to amend the Palmdale Trade and Commerce Center Specific Plan to remove the portion of the plan bound by Technology Drive to the north, Division Street to the east, Palmdale Boulevard to the south and State Route 14 to the west from the Palmdale Trade and Commerce Center Specific Plan; and,
(4) Specific Plan 20-001 for adoption of the Palmdale Transit Area Specific Plan.
PTASP Part 1
PTASP Part 2
10. Staff Communications
Megan Taggart, Acting Planning Manager
11. Planning Commission Communications
12. Adjournment to the regular Planning Commission Meeting of Thursday, November 12, 2020, at 7:00 p.m., in the City of Palmdale City Hall Council Chamber
